codes.means: the record names no standard, the bare unversioned URL written before versions, or another kind's standard
the record names a version of the group standard this package does not implement
codes.fix: install a version of @supersuit/group-md that implements it, or correct the standard the record names

codes.means: id is missing, does not equal the folder name, or is not lowercase letters, digits and dashes
codes.fix: set id to the folder name, or rename the folder to a slug
set name to what the group is called

codes.means: the record has no threads list and no legacy key standing in for one
codes.fix: add threads: [] or the threads the group talks in

codes.means: a thread entry is not a {app, id, name, seen} map, or its app is not imessage, whatsapp, telegram or signal
codes.fix: write the entry as a map with one of the four apps

codes.means: the same app and thread id is on two records, or twice on one
codes.fix: keep the thread on the one record it belongs to

codes.means: a thread is known only by its display name
codes.fix: group-md reconcile <dir> --threads <file> --apply fills the id from the app

codes.means: the same alias is on two records, so the finder refuses it
codes.fix: remove the alias from the record it does not mean

codes.means: the record is a flat <id>.md file, the legacy layout
the record still carries imessage_group, imessage_chat_guid or whatsapp_group
codes.fix: group-md migrate <dir> --apply, then --drop-legacy once nothing reads them
